description: This file contains benchmarks for comparing the performance of Orleans serialization against other serialization libraries for array types, specifically focusing on MyVector3 arrays. It includes serialization methods, setup of serializers, buffers, and benchmarking functions.

classes.name: ArraySerializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class that compares serialization performance of Orleans serializers with other serialization libraries for array types, using different buffer and stream strategies.

methods.name: MessagePackSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the array of MyVector3 using MessagePack.

methods.name: ProtobufNetSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the array using Protobuf-net serializer.

methods.name: OrleansSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the array using Orleans serializer.

methods.name: MessagePackBufferWriter
methods.description: Serializes the array into a BufferWriter using MessagePack.

methods.name: ProtobufNetBufferWriter
methods.description: Serializes the array into a BufferWriter using Protobuf-net.

methods.name: SystemTextJsonBufferWriter
methods.description: Serializes the array into a BufferWriter using System.Text.Json.

methods.name: OrleansBufferWriter
methods.description: Serializes the array into a BufferWriter using Orleans serializer with pooled writers.

methods.name: OrleansBufferWriter2
methods.description: Serializes the array into a BufferWriter wrapping an ArrayBufferWriter, then clears the buffer.

methods.name: OrleansPipeWriter
methods.description: Serializes the array using Orleans serializer into a Pipe writer.
